items.name: The Phantom of the Opera
items.description: Andrew Lloyd Webber's classic musical, celebrating 40 years in the West End in 2026 — the second longest-running musical in London's history. Famous for its fog-filled lake scene and elaborate masked ball.

items.name: Wicked
items.description: Multi-award-winning prequel to The Wizard of Oz, telling the untold story of the witches of Oz. Spectacular costumes, sets and one of the West End's most beloved scores.

items.name: Les Misérables
items.description: Victor Hugo's epic tale of love, redemption and revolution in 19th-century France, one of the longest-running musicals in the world. A West End staple since 1985.

items.name: Hamilton
items.description: Lin-Manuel Miranda's genre-defining hip-hop retelling of Founding Father Alexander Hamilton's life. One of the hardest tickets to get in London theatre.

items.name: Harry Potter and the Cursed Child
items.description: The eighth story in the Harry Potter series, picking up 19 years after the books end. Renowned for its stage magic and illusion work as much as its story.

items.name: Mamma Mia!
items.description: The ultimate feel-good jukebox musical built around ABBA's biggest hits. Bright, sparkly and guaranteed to have the audience singing along by the finale.

items.name: The Lion King
items.description: Disney's visually stunning stage adaptation, famous for its elaborate puppetry and costume design bringing the African savannah to life on stage.

items.name: Moulin Rouge! The Musical
items.description: A glamorous, high-energy jukebox musical bringing the world of Paris's most iconic cabaret to the stage, packed with mashups of contemporary pop hits.

items.name: The Book of Mormon
items.description: From the creators of South Park, an irreverent, sharply funny musical following two mismatched Mormon missionaries in Uganda. Not for the easily offended.

items.name: The Mousetrap
items.description: Agatha Christie's classic whodunit, the longest continuously running play in the world since 1952. Audiences are famously sworn to secrecy about the ending.

items.name: SIX
items.description: A concert-style pop musical reimagining Henry VIII's six wives as a girl group, telling their stories through their own voices. Fast, funny and only 80 minutes long.

items.name: Back to the Future: The Musical
items.description: A faithful, spectacle-driven stage adaptation of the beloved 1985 film, complete with a full-size DeLorean that appears to time-travel live on stage.
